title: +*INTRODUCTION TO LATINX/A/O-CHICANX/A/O STUDIES
description: Introduces key concepts and ideas in Latinx/a/o Studies, with a focus on the processes that led to the historical incorporation of various Latinx/a/o groups into the United States, and the factors that have shaped contexts of reception for Latinx/a/os and Chicanx/a/os historically. Explores connections and disconnections between historical and present-day discourses and processes.
